parts.label: Intake
parts.note: River water comes in through a screen

parts.label: Coagulant mixing
parts.note: Alum is stirred in fast to make particles stick

parts.label: Flocculation
parts.note: Slow paddles help the particles clump into flocs

parts.label: Settling tank
parts.note: The water moves slowly so the flocs sink

parts.label: Sludge
parts.note: Settled flocs, removed from the tank floor

parts.label: Sand filter
parts.note: Anthracite, sand and gravel strain out the last particles

parts.label: Chlorination
parts.note: A small dose of chlorine kills germs

parts.label: Clear water tank
parts.note: Clean water is stored, then pumped to homes
